limitations: Applies only to finite acyclic unit-flow polytopes having at least two route vertices, in their natural affine hull and flow lattice. Directed cycles, capacities, and general demands are not covered.
scientific_integrity: A complete elementary proof is supplied, with separately executable exact-integer finite checks. No independent correctness, originality, or publication-priority certification has been performed.
title: Exact Minkowski asymmetry of acyclic unit-flow polytopes from arc antichains
